title: AiZynthFinder Retrosynthesis
description: AI-driven retrosynthetic route planning using AiZynthFinder Monte Carlo tree search against a reaction template library.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

smiles_file.description: SMILES file (one SMILES per line) OR inline SMILES string. Provide either this or seed_smiles.

seed_smiles.description: Single target SMILES string. Used when smiles_file is not provided.

max_routes.description: Maximum number of synthesis routes to return per compound. Top routes by score.

max_depth.description: Maximum depth of the retrosynthesis tree. Deeper = more steps = longer search.

pass_max_steps.description: Routes with step count ≤ this value PASS the synthesisability gate. ≤4 steps is commercially accessible.

pass_min_score.description: Routes with MCTS score ≥ this value PASS. Score reflects template coverage and building block availability.

aizynthfinder_config.description: Path to AiZynthFinder YAML config specifying template library and stock DB.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
